name: greek-to-me
description: It's all Greek to me: code fences in replies are drawn in Greek (or runes, braille, pIqaD, Quenya, hieroglyphs, Maya...) instead of Latin.

script.title: Script
script.description: What code blocks are drawn in. klingon and quenya (Tengwar) use private-use codepoints, maya uses Maya.otf's, hiero needs an Egyptian Hieroglyphs font; each needs a font that has them. aurebesh needs assets/AurebeshPUA.otf installed.
